China Bamboo Flooring, Decking & Plywood Factory — Wholesale Direct

01 Who we are

Bothbest is an FSC-certified bamboo factory based in China, manufacturing bamboo flooring, decking, and plywood since 2001. Exporting worldwide with a proven reputation, we provide one-stop bamboo sourcing from indoor to outdoor, from floor to ceiling.

Recognized as a reliable and trustworthy bamboo supplier, Bothbest partners directly with importers, distributors, architects, designers, contractors, and builders across the globe.

02 What we have

Bothbest offers a complete product line with consistent quality and factory-direct pricing, including flooring, decking, panels, plywood, veneer, lumber, mats, countertops, and custom architectural bamboo. All products are CE certified for environmental safety.

Flooring covers solid, strand woven, click-lock, and engineered constructions. Outdoor decking includes standard, xtra, and carbonized options. Panels are available from 3mm to 80mm thick.

03 Why choose us

Bamboo is one of the world's most sustainable renewable resources due to its rapid growth cycle. As a giant grass, bamboo matures for harvest in 4–6 years compared to 25+ years for traditional hardwoods, growing up to 24 inches in 24 hours.

With over two decades of manufacturing expertise, Bothbest delivers guaranteed quality and responsive B2B service—helping you save by buying direct from the factory.

Hottest Bamboo

Solid Bamboo Flooring

Made from 100% rapidly renewable Moso bamboo in horizontal and vertical grains with tongue-and-groove milling. Available in natural, carbonized, and custom stained finishes. More

Wide Plank Bamboo Flooring

Long and wide 3-layer cross-laminated bamboo planks engineered for superior dimensional stability, requiring fewer joints and enabling faster installation. More

Strand Woven Bamboo Flooring

High-density (1,050 kg/m³) compressed bamboo flooring offering exceptional indentation resistance and durability for both residential and commercial spaces. More

Click Strand Woven Bamboo Flooring

Precision-profiled glue-less click-lock strand woven bamboo combining hardwood-like grain aesthetics with fast, floating DIY or contractor installation. More

Bamboo Veneer

Rotary or flat sliced from laminated bamboo blocks. An eco-friendly alternative to wood veneer featuring consistent grain, wide sheets, and clean machinability. More

Bamboo Plywood

Cross-laminated bamboo panels bonded with low-VOC eco-friendly adhesives in thicknesses from 3mm to 80mm for furniture, cabinetry, and interior architecture. More
